lessons.title: Combined Arms
lessons.text: Command a Timber Wolf, a tank and Elemental battle armor against a mixed force.

lessons.title: Movement plan
lessons.text: Vehicles and battle armor have their own movement and damage rules. Check their record sheets; use the Elementals to screen approaches.

lessons.title: Fire plan
lessons.text: Use the tank's firing arcs and keep the infantry out of unsupported open ground.

lessons.title: Review the tradeoffs
lessons.text: An OmniMech can carry eligible battle armor; inspect transport and anti-Mech options when adjacent.

lessons.title: Review
lessons.text: Review the battle record and retry to improve your practice.
